name: litellm

providers.ollama: litellm.completion(model='ollama_chat/' + model, api_base=WIRETRUTH_BASE_URL_OLLAMA, api_key=WIRETRUTH_API_KEY); host root
providers.gemini: litellm.completion(model='gemini/' + model, api_base=WIRETRUTH_BASE_URL_GEMINI + '/v1beta', api_key=WIRETRUTH_API_KEY); the runner supplies the host root and LiteLLM appends /models/...
providers.anthropic: litellm.completion(model='anthropic/' + model, api_base=WIRETRUTH_BASE_URL_ANTHROPIC, api_key=WIRETRUTH_API_KEY); host root, LiteLLM appends /v1/messages

finish.primary: choices[0].finish_reason; Responses model_dump(mode='json') preserves nested mappings on the forward-compatible model_construct fallback; reads status and incomplete_details.reason, output[].type for function_call, output[].content[].type for refusal, and error. Streaming Responses event.type, event.response and event.part.type. Error objects expose message; exception class/MRO and traceback select error_map and stack_top. Error data keeps outcome returned.
finish.raw: choices[0].provider_specific_fields['native_finish_reason'] when present (Gemini native values and remapped OpenAI Chat values in 1.105.5); otherwise the primary finish_reason itself. Anthropic and native Ollama normalize before constructing the choice and expose no separate original. No reconstruction from provider payloads or _hidden_params. Responses incomplete_details.reason or status.

text.primary: choices[0].message.content or streamed choices[0].delta.content; Responses output[].content[].text on output_text parts, or event.delta on response.output_text.delta

tool_calls.primary: choices[0].message.tool_calls or streamed choices[0].delta.tool_calls: id, function.name, function.arguments, and stream index. Responses output function_call items: call_id, name, arguments. Streaming event.item.type, call_id and name on output_item.added, event.output_index and event.delta on function_call_arguments.delta. Argument fragments joined by index and parsed with json.loads; no repair. Gemini signature-bearing ids include LiteLLM's __thought__ suffix, which is reported unchanged.

usage.primary: usage.prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens, completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens; Responses usage.input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, input_tokens_details.cached_tokens, output_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens. Last usage-bearing chunk is a snapshot, not a delta.

structured.primary: completion response_format=json_schema and Responses text.format=json_schema request the input schema. LiteLLM returns raw text, with no parsed structured value; the shim does not parse or validate that text. The forced named-tool parser is unsupported.

stream.primary: Chat ModelResponseStream iterator: no independent completion signal, so completed is null on normal return, false on a raised error. Responses event.type response.created/response.in_progress signals incomplete; response.completed/response.incomplete signals terminal completion, response.failed or error signals failure. event.response.error or event.error/message is returned error data. Iteration ending alone never means completion.

unsupported.reason: LiteLLM response_format selects native JSON output on claude-haiku-4-5; ordinary forced tool calls have no documented structured-result parser.

config_notes: LITELLM_LOCAL_MODEL_COST_MAP=True avoids an import-time network fetch. The 1.105.5 wheel's bundled map includes gpt-6-luna, gemini/gemini-3.8-flash, gemini/gemini-3.5-flash-lite, claude-sonnet-5-5 and claude-haiku-4-5. Compared with https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/main/model_prices_and_context_window.json fetched 2026-10-26, those entries differ at most in prices, not capability flags, so request behavior matches the default remote map. Offline imports without the flag log a failed fetch and use the same bundled map.
litellm.suppress_debug_info=True suppresses the informational banner; all library stdout is redirected to stderr. No retries, sampling defaults, thinking settings or parsing options are overridden.
openai 2.54.0 is pinned because LiteLLM 1.105.5 requires openai<3.
Gemini receives the /v1beta API base required by LiteLLM, rather than the runner's host root. LiteLLM's own injected temperature and reasoning mappings are retained.
Anthropic cache_control and per-tool eager_input_streaming are passed only when requested by the scenario. reasoning_effort is passed unchanged.

LITELLM_LOCAL_ANTHROPIC_BETA_HEADERS=True keeps the Anthropic beta-header config local too. The structured-outputs-2025-11-13 and fine-grained-tool-streaming-2025-05-14 mappings used by these calls match https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/main/litellm/anthropic_beta_headers_config.json, checked 2026-10-26, so the switch changes no request.

Native Ollama also sends a POST /api/show model-info request; replay's 404 and LiteLLM's fallback are retained. The lookup counts toward request limits, so request.no-injected-options on ollama notes SHOULD one-request (2 requests) and still passes.
Structured output uses the documented JSON schema request form without enabling optional client-side JSON validation. Raw output text is not claimed as a parsed structured success.
